title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Today's the day, and Hishiama (she's the dorm leader I mentioned!) is looking so cool right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: She was the absolute picture of a nifty city girl! In fact, seeing her made me realize just how many city girls I've seen since coming here.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I think I finally realized what a real city girl is. It's someone who dazzles brighter the more they overcome their problems… which means I can be a city girl too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: It's almost time for the race to start. I'm gonna ask my trainer to hold onto this letter so I can finish it after the race.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: But I swear, I'm gonna be more dazzling than every other runner out there! I'm off to finally become the city girl I've dreamed of!
